Name: Vanillin Deep Mines
Author: IVanillinI
Description:
[color=#a2c4c9][i]Adds 10 new, massive mine levels to the new mine location. Mines act as "resource banks," with several resource nodes, forages,
and monsters appearing daily.
You can "hoard" resources for up to 28 days, after which the resources begin to refresh, replacing old resources with new ones.
Each level has its own miniboss.
Mini-Bosses have increased stats and a custom loot pool.
Mini-Bosses appear every 28 days.
Each subsequent mine level is blocked by a strong barrier that requires an upgraded tool (a pickaxe or axe).
The deeper the mine level, the more upgraded the tool required to break the barrier.
To visit levels 9-10, you first need to visit the "Caldera" and "Qi Nut Room" respectively.

You can access the mines after completing the "Crafts Room" bundle; the entrance is near the quarry.
Or, if you install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28452]Vanillin Farmland Fields[/url] mod, the entrance is in the Farm Forest to the east of the entrance.[/i][/color]
